mode: offline retrospective model annotation, not online causal tracker

entity_registry.work_counter: Fixed kitchen worktop; apparent image motion can be egocentric camera motion.
entity_registry.red_colander_counter: Red perforated colander/filter basket initially on countertop near sink. NEVER the solid red drawer bowl.
entity_registry.drawer_lower: Lower pull-out drawer under worktop near the other person. Out of view before visible is NOT closed.
entity_registry.red_bowl_drawer: Solid red bowl in drawer, distinct from countertop perforated colander. Register unknown when not actually visible.
entity_registry.nested_metal_bowl: Metallic bowl nested in solid red drawer bowl; not an ordinary white dish on countertop.
entity_registry.vegetable_scrap: Small green vegetable/leaf remnant in camera wearer hand; NOT whole cabbage. Identity continuity uncertain if hidden.
entity_registry.cabbage_head: Large whole green cabbage, distinct from small remnant.
entity_registry.wearer_left_hand: Camera wearer anatomical left hand, generally small green remnant; do not assume holding in every frame.
entity_registry.wearer_right_hand: Camera wearer anatomical right hand. Do not swap with other person hands.
entity_registry.other_person: Visible dark-shirt person. Anonymous visual track; not linked to any transcript speaker or mental state.
entity_registry.other_person_bracelet_hand: Other person hand with visible silver wrist accessory. If identity not visually resolvable use unknown, do not switch IDs.
entity_registry.other_person_other_hand: Other person hand without that accessory; use unknown where identity unresolved.

annotation_caveat: GPT-6 visual estimates, not independent ground truth; stable IDs constrained by registry, continuity through occlusion is uncertain

social_context.text: do you need? I need another big bowl to put the garbage.
social_context.alignment: clip-level context only; no word/speaker time alignment
social_context.update_policy: context is not injected as a timestamped event; no new timed social evidence, therefore per-frame social_updates remain empty
